items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So we had Bobby White, Sonny Clark, Eugene Wright, and myself

ctx.x: Two and a half years. Yeah. And . . . after Art left I got Bobby White, Bobby White on drums who was excellent. And Kenny Drew recommended a fine young piano player, Sonny Clark. So we had Bobby White, Sonny Clark, Eugene Wright, and myself . . . after Art left.
Another big association that came, I guess while you were still, while the quartet was still together but you started working with Norman Granz and went out on Jazz at the Philharmonic tours.
